environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with sticky sessions disabled. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection handled through RDS Proxy in pinning-avoidance mode. The database connection role is `app_tenant_reader` which has RLS enforced via ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and ALTER TABLE invoices FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The role does NOT have BYPASSRLS. Additionally, the express-session configuration is overridden at the container level via environment variable SESSION_STORE_TYPE=redis pointing to ElastiCache Redis 7.x cluster with session validation middleware injected by the API Gateway (Kong) plugin `session-validator` v2.3 which performs session-origin binding by correlating the X-Forwarded-For header hash with a session creation fingerprint stored in Redis. The Kong plugin rejects requests where the session fingerprint doesn't match the originating IP subnet (/24 mask). PgBouncer is not used; RDS Proxy handles connection multiplexing with IAM authentication requiring the SET command to be issued within the same transaction boundary.

rls_policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_docs ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid)
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_invoices ON invoices USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid)
ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE invoices FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with sticky sessions disabled
config.session_fingerprint: X-Forwarded-For /24 subnet hash bound at session creation
